text: Cartrack trades in Portugal as Cartrack Portugal S.A., which Karooooo Ltd's FY2026 Form 20-F group-structure table lists as held 100% by Cartrack Ireland Limited; that table chains every layer of the group (Cartrack Ireland, Cartrack Technologies Pte. Ltd., Cartrack Holdings) at 100% up to Karooooo Ltd.
short: Cartrack Portugal S.A. is wholly inside the Karooooo Ltd group.

source.quote: Cartrack Portugal S.A. Cartrack Ireland Limited Portugal 100.0 100.0
